label: Suzma
note: In Central Asia strained qatiq (boiled milk set with its own starter), not Greek-style thermophilic yoghurt; Turkish süzme yoğurt is strained ordinary yoghurt

about.text: Strained yoghurt of Central Asia, drained from qatiq until it is thick; in Turkey it is süzme yoğurt, or kese yoğurdu, 'bag yoghurt'. Dried further, it becomes qurut.
